descriptionOps: Propose the whole setup of a site in one plan: the collections and singles to create (with fields and the records to import), the files you will change and the packages you will install. The plan waits for the project's builder to approve it on a trusted Mapled screen — nothing changes until then. Use this for the initial integration instead of creating collections one by one. Write the summary, notes, display names and help texts in English (records stay in the site's language). Record keys are the field keys: the lowercase, hyphenated display name ("Show badge" → "show-badge"). Relation fields name their target collection (one of this plan by its display name, or an existing one by key); give a record a "$ref" (a short name) and other records of the plan link to it by that name — links to existing collections use record ids.
